intent: The build loop: implements V1 test-first one component at a time, routes each component to its language craft skill, runs the component's own test command, guards non-test commands, and records a per-component 03-build-<name>.md artifact (with its plan-arch/design/spec inputs) that review and QA resume from.

dimensions.name: per-component-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records one 03-build-<name>.md run artifact per component so the run leaves BUILD.

dimensions.name: records-plan-inputs
dimensions.criterion: Each build records plan-arch; UI builds also the UI spec; a slice also its spec.

dimensions.name: language-routing
dimensions.criterion: Routes each component's language to the matching craft skill.

dimensions.name: tdd-language-routed
dimensions.criterion: Test-first, running the component's own test command, not a hardcoded runner.

dimensions.name: command-guard
dimensions.criterion: Guards any command beyond test/lint/typecheck/build; a flagged one is a hard gate.

dimensions.name: reads-not-writes
dimensions.criterion: Never edits the stack, PRD, or UI spec — reads them; changes are notes to owners.
